package contentaccess

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// Service applies the public Course visibility policy. Administrative and
// internal routes bypass it before calling these methods.
type Service struct {
	Repository repository.ContentAccessRepository
	ReadAccess repository.LessonReadAccessRepository
}

func (s Service) Configured() bool {
	return s.Repository != nil
}

func (s Service) RequireCourse(ctx context.Context, courseID string) error {
	return require(ctx, s.Repository, func(repo repository.ContentAccessRepository) (bool, error) {
		return repo.CanViewCourse(ctx, strings.TrimSpace(courseID))
	})
}

func (s Service) RequireModule(ctx context.Context, moduleID string) error {
	return require(ctx, s.Repository, func(repo repository.ContentAccessRepository) (bool, error) {
		return repo.CanViewModule(ctx, strings.TrimSpace(moduleID))
	})
}

func (s Service) RequireSection(ctx context.Context, sectionID string) error {
	return require(ctx, s.Repository, func(repo repository.ContentAccessRepository) (bool, error) {
		return repo.CanViewSection(ctx, strings.TrimSpace(sectionID))
	})
}

func (s Service) RequireLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID, relationID string) error {
	_, err := s.AuthorizeLesson(ctx, lessonID, relationID)
	return err
}

// AuthorizeLesson applies both structural navigation and inherited audience
// policy and returns the effective decision for response metadata.
func (s Service) AuthorizeLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID, relationID string) (LessonReadDecision, error) {
	lessonID = strings.TrimSpace(lessonID)
	relationID = strings.TrimSpace(relationID)
	err := require(ctx, s.Repository, func(repo repository.ContentAccessRepository) (bool, error) {
		if relationID != "" {
			return repo.CanViewLessonViaRelation(ctx, lessonID, relationID)
		}
		return repo.CanViewLesson(ctx, lessonID)
	})
	if err != nil {
		return LessonReadDecision{}, err
	}
	if isPrivilegedAudience(audienceFromContext(ctx)) {
		return LessonReadDecision{Effective: domain.DefaultLessonReadAccess, CanRead: true}, nil
	}
	decisions, err := s.ResolveLessons(ctx, []string{lessonID}, relationID != "")
	if err != nil {
		return LessonReadDecision{}, err
	}
	decision, ok := decisions[lessonID]
	if !ok {
		return LessonReadDecision{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if !decision.CanRead {
		return decision, lessonReadAccessError(audienceFromContext(ctx), decision.Effective)
	}
	return decision, nil
}

// LessonReadDecision is safe to expose in public lesson list responses.
type LessonReadDecision struct {
	Effective  domain.LessonReadAccess `json:"effective_read_access"`
	SourceType string                  `json:"read_access_source_type,omitempty"`
	SourceID   string                  `json:"read_access_source_id,omitempty"`
	CanRead    bool                    `json:"can_read"`
}

// ResolveLessons evaluates inherited policy in one batch, avoiding one query
// per lesson on catalog pages.
func (s Service) ResolveLessons(ctx context.Context, lessonIDs []string, includeHiddenCourses bool) (map[string]LessonReadDecision, error) {
	if s.ReadAccess == nil {
		return defaultLessonDecisions(lessonIDs), nil
	}
	resolutions, err := s.ReadAccess.ResolveLessonReadAccess(ctx, lessonIDs, includeHiddenCourses)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return decisionsForAudience(ctx, resolutions), nil
}

// ResolveCourseLessons evaluates inherited policy only through placements in
// one visible course. This prevents a reusable lesson from borrowing a more
// permissive policy from another course while rendering course navigation.
func (s Service) ResolveCourseLessons(ctx context.Context, courseID string, lessonIDs []string) (map[string]LessonReadDecision, error) {
	if s.ReadAccess == nil {
		return defaultLessonDecisions(lessonIDs), nil
	}
	resolver, ok := s.ReadAccess.(repository.CourseLessonReadAccessRepository)
	if !ok {
		return s.ResolveLessons(ctx, lessonIDs, false)
	}
	resolutions, err := resolver.ResolveCourseLessonReadAccess(ctx, strings.TrimSpace(courseID), lessonIDs)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return decisionsForAudience(ctx, resolutions), nil
}

func defaultLessonDecisions(lessonIDs []string) map[string]LessonReadDecision {
	result := make(map[string]LessonReadDecision, len(lessonIDs))
	for _, lessonID := range lessonIDs {
		result[lessonID] = LessonReadDecision{Effective: domain.DefaultLessonReadAccess, CanRead: true}
	}
	return result
}

func decisionsForAudience(ctx context.Context, resolutions map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution) map[string]LessonReadDecision {
	result := make(map[string]LessonReadDecision, len(resolutions))
	audience := audienceFromContext(ctx)
	for lessonID, resolution := range resolutions {
		result[lessonID] = LessonReadDecision{
			Effective:  resolution.Effective,
			SourceType: resolution.SourceType,
			SourceID:   resolution.SourceID,
			CanRead:    canReadLesson(audience, resolution.Effective),
		}
	}
	return result
}

type audienceContextKey struct{}

// WithAudience attaches the gateway role to access checks. An empty role is a
// guest, so public routes remain usable without authentication.
func WithAudience(ctx context.Context, role string) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, audienceContextKey{}, strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(role)))
}

func audienceFromContext(ctx context.Context) string {
	role, _ := ctx.Value(audienceContextKey{}).(string)
	if role == "" {
		return "GUEST"
	}
	return role
}

func isPrivilegedAudience(role string) bool {
	switch role {
	case "ADMIN", "MODERATOR", "TEACHER":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func canReadLesson(role string, access domain.LessonReadAccess) bool {
	if isPrivilegedAudience(role) {
		return true
	}
	switch access {
	case domain.LessonReadAccessGuest:
		return true
	case domain.LessonReadAccessStudent:
		return role == "STUDENT" || role == "STUDENT_PRO"
	case domain.LessonReadAccessStudentPro:
		return role == "STUDENT_PRO"
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func lessonReadAccessError(role string, required domain.LessonReadAccess) error {
	code := "lesson_reading_forbidden"
	switch {
	case required == domain.LessonReadAccessDisabled:
		code = "lesson_reading_disabled"
	case role == "GUEST":
		code = "lesson_authentication_required"
	case required == domain.LessonReadAccessStudentPro:
		code = "lesson_pro_required"
	}
	return &domain.LessonReadAccessError{Code: code, Required: required}
}

func (s Service) RequireTask(ctx context.Context, taskID, relationID string) error {
	return require(ctx, s.Repository, func(repo repository.ContentAccessRepository) (bool, error) {
		if strings.TrimSpace(relationID) != "" {
			return repo.CanViewTaskViaRelation(ctx, strings.TrimSpace(taskID), strings.TrimSpace(relationID))
		}
		return repo.CanViewTask(ctx, strings.TrimSpace(taskID))
	})
}

func (s Service) RequireExample(ctx context.Context, exampleID, relationID string) error {
	return require(ctx, s.Repository, func(repo repository.ContentAccessRepository) (bool, error) {
		if strings.TrimSpace(relationID) != "" {
			return repo.CanViewExampleViaRelation(ctx, strings.TrimSpace(exampleID), strings.TrimSpace(relationID))
		}
		return repo.CanViewExample(ctx, strings.TrimSpace(exampleID))
	})
}

func require(
	_ context.Context,
	repo repository.ContentAccessRepository,
	check func(repository.ContentAccessRepository) (bool, error),
) error {
	if repo == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	allowed, err := check(repo)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !allowed {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}
